recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-14403 clarification without broadening the issue into later search modifier semantics work.
issue_request: FHIR-14403 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search page issue asking to clarify uri search examples by showing the :below and :above modifiers and making clear that the unmodified ValueSet.url example is exact matching.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn commit 8c37215b0cdde1516a112073fb5b88b3c29d0285, matching Jira's svn revision 13075 comment. That commit added ValueSet?url:below and ValueSet?url:above examples to source/search.html and replaced the ambiguous paragraph with per-line explanations; the examples survived the later search page restructuring.
additional_context: The triggering community.fhir.org thread confirms the problem was an exact URI example being described as prefix matching, plus uncertainty about :above. Current source later added a dedicated above-with-uri section that defines URL path-segment matching and lists http://acme.org/fhir/ValueSet/123 as an ancestor of http://acme.org/fhir/ValueSet/123/_history/5. The shorter uri section still omitted the /fhir segment in the same ancestor example.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html so the short uri section's third example says :above also matches http://acme.org/fhir/ValueSet/123, aligning it with the example URL and the detailed URI modifier section.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the URI :above example explanation from http://acme.org/ValueSet/123 to http://acme.org/fhir/ValueSet/123.

related_jiras.note: Later uri search clarification about ValueSet.url being a uri search parameter; already audited separately on the combined branch and not a duplicate FHIR-14403 decision.
